# SHABAAN

> SHABAAN is an online personal training and nutrition coaching service (Arabic-language, Egypt-based). This site is a single-page landing page describing the coaching packages, pricing, and how to subscribe.

Coaching plans, pricing, client results, and audio testimonials are on the homepage. Subscription and contact happen entirely through WhatsApp — there is no in-page checkout or account system. The `/admin` area is a private content-management dashboard for the site owner only; it is not part of the public offering and should not be crawled or indexed (see `/robots.txt`).

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://shabaan-online-coaching.vercel.app/): Full landing page — hero, "how it works" steps, training/nutrition packages and pricing, client transformation gallery, audio testimonials, FAQ, and WhatsApp contact.
- [Sitemap](https://shabaan-online-coaching.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap.

## Packages

- Training + Nutrition (تدريب + تغذية): 799 EGP/month — full coaching plan with continuous follow-up.
- Nutrition only (تغذية فقط): 599 EGP/month — nutrition plan with follow-up and adjustments.

## Contact

- WhatsApp: +20 100 025 7565
